This is the repository of Extra Biome Travels exclusively for 1.12.2 and is not affiliated with Traverse or ports of ExtrabiomesXL. Please do not report any bugs originating from these projects, they will immediately be closed and marked as invalid.

Make sure that the bug you are reporting happens on the LATEST version of Extra Biome Travels, especially if you are playing on a modpack that hasn't been updated in awhile. It is likely that the bug you are reporting has already been fixed and will count as an invalid issue.
